translations.translatedText: # Thursday 4.7.2019 (radio)

The opposition parties are at the top of Yle's party support poll. Gillnet fishing is to be banned to protect the Saimaa ringed seal. Sales of organic food are growing. The blueberry harvest may be poor, but the lingonberry harvest may be good.
## Party support
![Party support](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10861286)
Open image viewer
Photo: Tanja Ylitalo / Yle
The opposition parties, The Finns Party and the National Coalition Party, are the most popular parties in Yle's new party support poll.
In June's poll, support for The Finns Party is almost 20 percent and support for the National Coalition Party is almost 17 percent.

Among the government parties, support for the Social Democrats (SDP) and the Centre Party has fallen. Support for the Centre Party is now at a record low. Less than 12 percent of respondents supported the Centre Party.
Support for the other government parties, that is the Greens, the Left Alliance and the Swedish People's Party (RKP), has risen a little.

Tuomo Turja, research director at Taloustutkimus, says that the SDP has now lost supporters to the Left Alliance. In addition, both the SDP and the Centre Party are losing supporters to The Finns Party.
## Protecting the Saimaa ringed seal
![Saimaa ringed seals lounge on skerries during the moulting season in May.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10219342)
Open image viewer
A Saimaa ringed seal basks in the sun on a skerry. Photo: Petri Vironen / Yle
Gillnet fishing is to be banned completely in the habitat of the Saimaa ringed seal. A citizens' initiative has been submitted on the matter.
At present, gillnet fishing is banned in the Saimaa ringed seal's habitats from the middle of April to the end of June.
This year the gillnet fishing ban ended on Monday of this week. Since then, 4 dead seal pups have already been found in Saimaa. The pups had become entangled in the nets.
Despite the sad news about the pups, the Saimaa ringed seal population has strengthened. Perhaps just under 400 seals now live in Saimaa. Perhaps about 70 pups were born this year.
## Popularity of organic food
![Organic products on a supermarket shelf.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-6317057)
Open image viewer
Sales of organic food are growing steadily. Photo: Tarja Nyyssönen / Yle
The popularity of organic food is growing steadily.

Sales of organic food have grown by about 10 percent a year, both here and around the world, since 2000, says a report by the Natural Resources Institute Finland. In this decade, sales of organic products in Finland have grown by more than 10 percent a year.
Last year shops sold organic products worth more than 330 million euros in total. Organic's market share is still small, however. Organic makes up only 2.4 percent of food retail sales.
## Berry harvest outlook
![Blueberry shoots with flowers.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5566502)
Open image viewer
Blueberries are in flower. Photo: Raine Martikainen / Yle
The blueberry harvest will be average or poor this summer. The Natural Resources Institute Finland's estimate is based on the number of blueberry flowers and unripe berries.
The lingonberry harvest, on the other hand, may be good. The harvest may be good if the lingonberry flowers are successfully pollinated, the Natural Resources Institute Finland says.
The flowering of the cloudberry, that is, the bramble, has already ended. The Natural Resources Institute Finland says that the number of cloudberry flowers has been average or even more abundant.
